text: The Interior is a landmark in . It is located in the Lifehold Core. This landmark can only be accessed during Chapter 12. It is the site of the game's final bosses in the original version. Before entering the Interior, the player is given a prompt to enter or wait and prepare. Entering the Interior is the point of no return. At the center of the interior, the Skells are given Skell Fuel Recovery. Although it is a sheltered location, after entering the HUD shows the weather to be thunderstorms, regardless of what the weather was outside. The weather changes to clear for the second phase of the final boss battle.

Ignit, the Ultimate Chaos (Japanese: , Konzetsu no Igunīto) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Coronid family. It can be found at level 88 at Lake Ciel in Sylvalum during crimson auroras, where it replaces the largest Ancient Coronid.

The Intermediate Arsenal Qmoeva (Japanese: , Chūkan Busō-gata Kumūba) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Qmoeva Ganglion's skell. It can be found at level 35 above Silent Mire in Primordia during nighttime.

Imbecile Saltats (Japanese: , Sutyūpido Sarutāto, Stupid Saltat) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Saltat family, and can be found at level 48-50 at the Cryptic Sign in Oblivia. They have group loyalty with each other and with the Zirconium Fal-swo above. Some may be replaced with Rapture Saltats.

Inferno Skydon is a Medium Skell in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is the level 60 version of the Inferno skell, and becomes available after completing Chapter 12. Like all other Level 60 Skells it cannot be purchased, but instead must be created at the AM Terminal.
Infernium is a Precious Resource in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Three bars are needed for the Normal Mission The Big Bang.
Iron Knuckle is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Samurai Gunner at rank 4.
Interfearence is a Mission Exclusive Secondary Boss in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Human-Made Skell piloted by Dale Gibbon and can be fought at level 57 in Sylvalum during Serial Thriller.

The Imp Lophid (Japanese: , Inpu Rofiru) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Lophid family, and can be found at level 32 at Sayram Northeast Plain in Primordia. Defeating it is required during the A route of the Normal Mission Here Come the Brides.
Inner Search is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Enforcer at rank 2. Cross, Irina, Doug, Hope, Celica, Yelv and Mia can use this skill.
Installation is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is one of the three missions H.B. issues during A New Rival?.

Impulse Qmoevas (Japanese: , Doraivu Kumūba) are two Mission Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are level 40 Qmoevas, and must be defeated at Cauldros's Kw'arah Cloister during Alex's Last Stand.

Intra Monoceroses (Japanese: , Intara Unikoru) are five Mission Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Monoceros family, and are fought at level 29-30 at West Ciel Sandsea in Sylvalum during Predator and Prey.

In the forest is a track in Xenoblade Chronicles X, composed and arranged by Hiroyuki Sawano. It is track 10 of disc three in the XenobladeX Original Soundtrack. It contains vocals and original lyrics provided by mpi. This track plays when the party battles the Yggralith Zero or Phanatos, the Netherlord.
The Internment Camp Key is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. One of two is required to open the internment camp during Prone Sweet Prone.

In Need of a Hand is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Shiraton and the primary destination is the Commercial District of New Los Angeles. Although not required to accept it, this mission leads into the Normal Mission A Dubious Operation.
In Search of New Horizons is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Nopon Commerce Guild and the primary destination is Noctilum.

In Support of Science is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Min'barac and the primary destination is the Residential District of New Los Angeles. This mission leads into The Bug Whisperer, though accepting it is not a prerequisite.
Incomprehensible Weapon is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Factory 1.21 and the primary destination is Sylvalum.
Introspection is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located northwest of Division Drive in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles between Yelv and Cross during the evening.

Ictus Shells are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Ictuses, or for 90 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in X, XV, and XX Physical Res Up and SpecUp.PHYS-RES augments.

Imperial Sphinx Fangs are intergalactic materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Sphinxes, including the Tainted Sphinx, or for 210 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They can also be earned by completing the Time Attack Mission The Infernal Beast. They are components in X, XV, and XX Melee: Blaze and M-Auto.BLAZE augments.

Ingrown Virago Claws are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Viragos, or for 138 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in X, XV, and XX Side Attack Plus and PositionDmg.SIDE augments. One is needed for Partners in Prototyping.

Insidia Mohawks are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Insidias, or for 54 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in I and V Crush Surge augments. Two of them are needed for Partners in Prototyping (Insidia Mohawks).
Insidia A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a green insidia variant. It can be obtained from Lambert, the Divine Wind in Noctilum.
Insidia B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a red insidia variant. It can be obtained from Griffus, the Tartarean in Noctilum.
Ictus A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a pink ictus variant. It can be obtained from Valyrian, the Iron Cleaver in Oblivia.
Ictus B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a green ictus variant. It can be obtained from Belenguer, the Gunhammer in Oblivia.
Ictus C is a Holofigure in . It depicts a purple ictus variant. It can be obtained from Terenty, the Blademaster in Cauldros.

Innovation Inspiration is a special Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a Ma-non and Orphean looking at a new kind of mineral called Phogrium, which was discovered in Sylvalum by Frye during Brotherly Love. It is obtained as a reward for completing this Normal Mission.

Insect Retribution is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.3, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting ten Insectoids. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Indigen Exodus is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.5, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting eight Marnucks. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Insectoids (Japanese: , Insekuto) are a category of enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It includes creatures that resemble insects, arachnids, myriapods, crustaceans, and earthworms. Insectoids have the widest distribution across the five regions of Mira, alongside Theroids, with twenty two types. They are also the only enemy type to possess natural camouflage, with a large majority of the species disguising themselves as flora or natural formations. Regular Insectoids resist all forms of Physical attacks, and also share common weakness traits to Thermal and Ether based attacks, with some exceptions, and airborne Insectoids also being weak to Gravity attacks, and no resistances, with Tyrants u
Incapacitation Surge is an armor Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X that increases the chance of triggering the Last Words Soul Voice.
Insectoid Criticals Up is a ground weapon critical Augment in and that increases critical chance when attacking Insectoid-classified enemies. The Skell equivalent is CriticalUp.INSECTOID.
Insectoid Slayer is a ground weapon enemy exploit Augment in and that increases damage dealt to Insectoid-classified enemies. The Skell equivalent is Slayer.INSECTOID.

Iron Blades are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Dual Swords in the Blades Series. They can only be obtained from the Shop Terminal on Armory Alley for 2,700 Credits. Iron Blades must be purchased as an objective for the Normal Mission Mamma Mia!.
Irina's Bodywear is Light Wear torso armor in and . It is manufactured by Sakuraba Industries. It is part of Irina's initial gear when she joins the team, and cannot be obtained any other way.

Iron Swords are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Longswords. One must be purchased during the Normal Mission The Bodyguard together with the Warrior Assault Rifle and the Titanium Shield in order to arm Zazazan's bodyguard, Harvey.
Intrepid Glaives are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Longswords. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 190,800 Credits.
Intrepid Glaives II are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Longswords. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 286,200 Credits.
Iron Slairs are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Longswords. They can be purchased from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 3,300 Credits.
Iron Slairs II are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Longswords. They can be purchased from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 3,300 Credits.
Iron Swords II are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Longswords. They can be purchased from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 4,500 Credits.
Intrepid Lances are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Javelins. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 248,000 Credits.
Iron Bolides are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Javelins. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 3,900 Credits.
Iron Parces are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Javelins. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 4,200 Credits.
Iron Spears are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Javelins. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 3,900 Credits.
Iron Spears II are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Javelins. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 5,800 Credits.
Intrepid Edges are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Dual Swords in the Edges Series. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 171,700 Credits.
Intrepid Edges II are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Dual Swords in the Edges II Series. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 171,700 Credits.
Iron Blades II are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Dual Swords in the Blades II Series. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 4,000 Credits.
Iron Ralzes are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Dual Swords in the Ralzes Series. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 2,900 Credits.
Iron Paives are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Shields in the Paive Series. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 3,900 Credits.
Iron Shields are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Shields in the Shield Series. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 3,600 Credits.

|-|Normal = |-|Advanced = Iron Knives are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Knives in the Knife Series. The Normal and Advanced Iron Knives can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley and the Origin Blatta respectively.
Iron Knives II are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Knives in the Knife II Series. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 3,600 Credits.
Iron Knives III are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Knives in the Knife III Series. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 2,400 Credits.
Iron Rivs are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Knives in the Riv Series. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 2,600 Credits.
Infinite Comm is a BLADE head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can only be obtained by crafting.

Infinite Plastron is a BLADE torso armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can only be obtained by crafting. It is a silver version of the armor seen in Chapter 12. Colour variants are available in the Regal, Reginal, and True Plastrons, which are red, black, and gold respectively.
Infinite Bangle R is a BLADE arm armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can only be obtained by crafting.
Infinite Bangle L is a BLADE arm armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can only be obtained by crafting.
Irina's Legwear is Medium Wear leg armor in and . It is manufactured by Sakuraba Industries. It is part of Irina's initial gear when she joins the team, and cannot be obtained any other way.
Irina's Armwear L is Light Wear right arm armor in and . It is manufactured by Sakuraba Industries. It is part of Irina's initial gear when she joins the team, and cannot be obtained any other way.
Irina's Armwear R is Light Wear right arm armor in and . It is manufactured by Sakuraba Industries. It is part of Irina's initial gear when she joins the team, and cannot be obtained any other way.
Infinite Cords are BLADE leg armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can only be obtained by crafting.
Incapacitation, or Incapacitated, is a recurring status effect in .

Infinite Telethia Pens are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be obtained from Polkan Telethia in Colony 6 and no one has them availible for trade. According to their description, they are pens that write forever and are kind to the environment.
Insect Jaws are materials in . They are common materials, and can be dropped by Cave Skeeters, Worker Arachno, Director Arachno, and different kinds of Pods.
Invincible is an Aura in . It prevents the character from being hit by any attacks.
Indol (Japanese: , Ākedia, Acēdia) is a Titan in . It is ruled by the Indoline Praetorium, who worship and revere the Titan. It is a dragon-like Titan that flies above the Cloud Sea.
Iron Wall (Japanese: , Aian'u~ōru) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using a Shield Hammer.

Impassable Edgar (Japanese: , Teppeki no Rainā) is a Unique Monster in . He is a member of the Garlus family and can be found at level 60 at Declessa Altar Hill on the Lower Level of the Kingdom of Tantal. He must be defeated in order to unlock Zenobia's level 5 "Leaping" Field Skill and Theory's level 5 Frost Banish Blade Special.
The Indoline Sanctum (Japanese: , Ākedia Daiseidō) is a Location in . It corresponds to the area of the same name, which is found in the Indoline Praetorium.

The Isle of Sleeping Remains (Japanese: , Ikō no Nemurujiima) is a landmark in . It is located in the Rigitte Waters in the Leftherian Archipelago and is connected by walkways to Daridan's Stack and the Lud Cloudway: Rigitte. Enemies often spawn in response to approach, and so cannot be detected until the player is close to them.
The Isle of Terminomni (Japanese: , Banbutsu no Shūchakutō) is a location in . It is located under Godsford Isle in the Fonsett Waters in the Leftherian Archipelago.

Idora Cave (Japanese: , Idora no Dōkutsu) is a location in . It is located on the Upper Level of the Cliffs of Morytha, beyond the Morytha Falls. It leads into the Runo Cave-in, and then the Path of the Believer.
The Industrial Zone, Upper Duct (Japanese: , Seizō Kukaku Jōsō Dakuto) is a Landmark in . It is located in the Old Factory in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

Implacable Dylan (Japanese: , Tataki no Azuma) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Riik family and can be found at level 23 in the Acid Gullet, North of the Gullet Pass in the Head of the Kingdom of Uraya. It must be defeated in order to unlock Zenobia's level 2 "Greatest Warrior" Affinity Reward.
Imperial Secret Escapes are Literature Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Haskefell Books in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain. They are one of the favorite Pouch items of Gorg.
The Ikthus Deeds are a Store Deed key item in . They can be purchased from the Ikthus Fishmongers in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Ikthus Fishmongers is a shop in . It is run by Merve and can be found in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya. It is specialized in Seafood.
Isalle is an NPC in . She is an Urayan who can be found in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya. Isalle runs a shop called Shellbrow Wagon specialized in Desserts.

Indoline Teas are Drink items in . They can be purchased from Cafe Lutino in the Indoline Praetorium; during Chapter 9 the cafe moves to the Leftherian Archipelago's Fonsett Village. They are one of the favorite Pouch items of Sheba.

The Infant Ardun (Japanese: , Yōnen no Arudon) is an enemy in . It is a member of the Ardun family, and can be found at level 1 at Kloom Farm in the Gormott Province. This enemy drops no items, and will not respawn. It is recommended to not defeat the enemy, and to complete Ardun Rearing instead, to gain access to a Unique Monster Feeding the Ardun during the quest Ardun Rearing will change it to: * Infant Ardun (Lv 1) * Young Ardun (Lv 20) * Youthful Ardun (Lv 40) * Adult Ardun (Lv 60) * Ominous Ardun (Lv 80) * Relentless Arduran (Lv 99)

Insectivore Malcom (Japanese: , Kaerugui no Sunīku) is a Unique Monster in . He is a member of the Vang family and can be found at level 75 in an underground passage between Coolley Lake and Varnax's Plunge on the Upper Level - Right of the Gormott Province during clear or overcast weather.

The Infernal Guldo (Japanese: , Debirukingu Gurudu) is a Boss in . It is a member of the Guldo family and is fought at level 60 in the Womb Center in the Land of Morytha. Upon its defeat, it drops an ID card that Rex picks up. Two of them can also be fought at level 63 during the Challenge Battle Dread Contagion.
Intermediate Weaponry are Key Items in . They add 2500 WP to a weapon class of a Driver. They can be received as rewards for completing a Blade's Affinity Chart.

Indoline Murals is an Info Item in . It hints at the location of the Mysterious Part D. It can be obtained by examining the mural which is on a wall behind some tents in the northwest corner of the Refugee Campground in the Indoline Praetorium. Once the Indoline Praetorium becomes inaccessible, the Leftherian Murals may be used to obtain Mysterious Part D instead.

Illumi Skeeters (Japanese: , Irumi Sukīto) are enemies in . They are members of the Skeeter family and can be found in the Kingdom of Uraya, particularly at level 37-39 in Fonsa Myma Waters and level 41-44 at the Old Quarry. They can be summoned at level 35 - 37 by Femni Nest's art "Emergence". Five of them must be defeated to unlock Roc's level 2 "Wind Mastery".

Idle Rodonyas (Japanese: , Aidoru Mūsu) are enemies in . They are members of the Rodonya family, and can be found at level 40-41 at the Argan Iceblooms on the Lower Level of the Kingdom of Tantal. Four of them must be defeated at level 41 during Cannadea's Troubles.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Incenses of Calm (Japanese: , Odayakana Kōsui) are accessories in and . They boost the wearer's resistance to the Stench debuff by up to 70%. The Incense of Insight accessory offers a stronger instance of this equipment's effect.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Incenses of Insight (Japanese: , Satori no Kōsui) are accessories in and . They boost the wearer's resistance to the Stench debuff by up to 100%, allowing for full immunity to the status. They are the upgraded version of the Incense of Calm accessory.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Infantry Vests (Japanese: , Yōhei no Besuto) are accessories in and . They increase the wearer's maximum HP stat by up to 500. They are the upgraded version of the Rigid Vest accessory. For a similar multiplicative effect that can stack with this gear, check the Gear Vest, Abyss Vest, Jade Vest, Titanium Vest and Twin Trunks Vest accessories. Other sources of maximum HP apply before this fixed stat bonus.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Infinity Symbols (Japanese: , Infiniti Shinboru) are accessories in and . They slightly fill the Party Gauge after completing a Chain Attack, by up to 40. Having one equipped to each party member allows for a full Party Gauge segment to be restored after the end of a Chain Attack. This Party Gauge increase is not affected by Party Gauge gain boosting effects from Pouch Items, but will be affected by difficulty parameters.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Iron Headbands (Japanese: , Tetsu no Hachimaki) are accessories in and . They increase the damage of Critical Hits by up to 30%. Common variants can be purchased at the Peatopaz Accessories shop in the Empire of Mor Ardain. The Ice Headband, Optical Headband and Crimson Headband accessories offer stronger instances of this equipment's effect.
Insect Chips are Mechanical collectibles in . They can be found in Temperantia.
Iron Seedlings are Mechanical collectibles in . They can be found in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Inferno Wheel (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using Twin Rings.

The Informant (Japanese: , Jōhōya) is a shop in . It is run by Mumufa and can be found in Goldmouth at the Argentum Trade Guild. It is specialized in Information. Switch Parts 1 is available for purchase after starting the quest Bana's Secret Treasure.

Iona is an NPC in . She is a young girl who lives in Fonsa Myma, the capital of the Kingdom of Uraya. She looks up to her caretaker and adoptive grandfather, Cole. She can usually be found just outside the Mymoma Playhouse. She knows Vandham as he and Cole are old friends.
Impregnable Shield (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Zeke's arts when using a Shield Hammer.

Iron Chips are Core Chips in and . They can be purchased from Shroomblade Smithing in Goldmouth and dropped by a variety of low-level enemies. Iron Chips share their appearance with Cobalt Chips, Gold Chips and Steel Chips. Mythra's default weapon has an Iron Chip equipped. __TOC__

Igna Investigation is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Uraya by talking to Hamlish at the Mercenary HQ, after Garfont Mercenaries reaches Merc Level 2. The time required to complete this mission is 40 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 10 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Keen Eye" and "Dark Mastery" Field Skills.
Igard Skwarors (Japanese: , Igādo Sutora) are enemies in . They are members of the Skwaror family, and can be found at level 40-45 at Daridan's Stack in the Leftherian Archipelago.

Indoline Sentinels (Japanese: , Ākedia Miritia) are enemies in . They are Indoline Titans, and can be found at level 60-62 at the 7th Perimeter Skyport in the World Tree. Four of them must be defeated to unlock Pandoria's level 3 "Electric Mastery" Field Skill.

The Indignant Gogol (Japanese: , Hifun no Gogōru) is a quest-exclusive boss in . It is a member of the Gogol family, and is fought three times at level 50 on the path to the Sacred Ice Caverns in the Kingdom of Tantal during Tender-Hearted Beast.
Ismet is an NPC in . Ismet is an Ardainian researcher who can be found at the Ardainian Garrison in Temperantia. Ismet gives the quest Judicium's Legacy.
The Inherited Core Crystal is a special Core Crystal in . It allows the party to awaken Sheba and can be purchased from Margia's Odds & Ends in Torigoth for 500,000 G.
Inns are an Info Item in . It can be purchased from the Informant shop in the Argentum Trade Guild.

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Indoor Attack Up (Japanese: , Shitsunai Kōgeki Appu) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM/Upgrade in and . It increases damage dealt by up to 45% when the user is in an indoors area. Any area with a roof above the character's head is treated as being indoors. Despite being inside their respective Titan's bodies, most areas in Uraya's Stomach and Tantal's Head, Upper and Lower Level are not considered indoors. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Insect Hunter (Japanese: , Insekuto Hantā) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM/Upgrade in and . It increases the damage dealt against Insects by up to 45%. Insect-type enemies belong to the following enemy species: Antol, Arachno, Caterpile, Eluca, Gyanna, Nest, Parisax, Plambus, Pod and Scorpox. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__

The Infallible Tirkin (Japanese: , Hyappatsuhyakuchū no Tākin) is a Quest Exclusive Enemy in . It is a Tirkin fought at level 10 in front of a giant tree near Torigoth in the Gormott Province, alongside the Resourceful Tirkin, during Crane Criminals.

Invitation from Queen is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Uraya during the Blade Quest Bearing Her Soul, after Ursula obtains 3,000 fans. The time required to complete this mission is 40 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 10 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Fire Mastery" and "Light Mastery" Field Skills. It rewards a lot of stamps that are necessary to level up Ursula's attributes. It also increases Ursula's fanbase by a large amount.

Invitation from Emperor is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Argentum Trade Guild during the Blade Quest Bearing Her Soul, after Ursula obtains 3,500 fans. The time required to complete this mission is 40 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 10 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Wind Mastery" and "Earth Mastery" Field Skills. It rewards a lot of stamps that are necessary to level up Ursula's attributes. It also increases Ursula's fanbase by a large amount.

This page lists all the Merc Missions available in the Indoline Praetorium. The list may be viewed in the order they appear in the Merc Group Log. Terms and abbreviations are explained in the legend at the bottom of the page. |-| Mission Log = Mission Log |-| Requirements and Rewards = Requirements and Rewards * Base reward values for Gold and Experience are increased with higher Merc Levels.

Irving (Japanese: , Isuhaku) is an NPC in . He is a devout Ardainian soldier who can be found atop Bathein Watchtower in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain. He is the finest sniper in the 12th Company, and one of the best in the Empire, taking after Bathein himself. He therefore sets himself on the tower to act as watchman in direct defiance of his superior's orders. Due to his firing skill nobody except the party are able to get close enough to talk him down. After leaving the watchtower, Irving reluctantly moves to his station in Temperantia, where he again challenges the party to a sniping competition.

Industrial Sort of Tour is a DLC Quest in . It is one of five quests released as downloadable content, the New Quests Pack 1 of the Expansion Pass. After starting chapter 5 and collecting the unlock item from the "Expansion Pass" menu, the quest can be received from Toutour by Port Anangham in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
This quest is missable and will expire during Chapter 8. Indol's Teachings is a quest in . It can be received from Mololo on Quattor Street in the Indoline Praetorium.
Insurgent Investigations is a quest in . It can be received from Stulc in Hardhaigh Palace in the Empire of Mor Ardain. This quest will be available once We Meet Again has been completed.

Impassioned Thoughts is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located east of Mizar, Elevator #8 on the Lower Level of the World Tree. It features a conversation between Agate, her Driver, Tora, and Poppi α. It must be viewed to unlock Agate's level 3 Keen Eye Field Skill. __FORCETOC__
Ioannis is an NPC in . He is a Tantalese who can be found in the Residential Area of Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal at night. Ioannis offers the Merc Mission Shaking Icicles.

The Imbalanced Gogol (Japanese: , Aizō no Gogōru) is a quest-exclusive enemy in . It is a member of the Gogol family, and can be found at level 45 on an outcropping of Godsford Isle in the Leftherian Archipelago alongside the Jealous Gogol during the DLC quest Beneath the Aurora.
Isset is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian who can be found in the Ayvill Shopping District of Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain. He runs a shop called Belchett Recycling.
Increasing Affinity is an Info Item in . It can be purchased from the Informant shop at the Plaza of Reprieve of Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya.

Into the Air is a Skill RAM/Upgrade in . It increases damage dealt against launched enemies by up to 150%. It is equivalent in effect to the Swordfighting Banner, Goddess Banner, Ancient Banner and War God Banner accessories. It can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__

Into the Ground is a Skill RAM/Upgrade in . It increases damage dealt against toppled enemies by up to 150%. It is equivalent in effect to the Mechanized Greaves, Crystal Greaves, Graphite Greaves and Staunch Boots accessories. It can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__

Invading Spike Urchons (Japanese: , Shinkō no Supaiku Unin) are three quest-exclusive enemies in . They are members of the Urchon family, and can be found at level 38 at the Bluestep Ditch in the Kingdom of Uraya during Sniff out the Spy.

Indomitable Will is a Heart-to-Heart in . Jade Face (Japanese: , Midori no Feisu), also known as Green Face, and referred to as Face 20814 by Egil, is a Faced Mechon in . He has two guns, one on each shoulder. He seems to use the left gun more often than the right in cutscenes. Shulk and the others first encounter Jade Face at 1st Zebrai Bulkhead, on the fifth floor of Mechonis Field. It is revealed that Jade Face is controlled by Gadolt. During this battle, five types of Story Exclusive Mechon apply assistance to Jade Face. They are two Defensive/ONIONs, one M66/TRICK, four M45/VIOLAs, one calling for reinforcements two Offensive/SCOUTs, another two Offensive/HONEYs, and two others one of each.

In Colony 6, she can be found at night nearby the stairs leading to the balcony where Norara is during the day (and Mefimefi at night, if invited), around the central area of Colony 6's main street, almost exactly in the center of the circle that is Colony 6. After Nopon Determination or Homs Determination is completed, she moves to the balcony next to either Mefimefi or Perrine.
